steps.content: ...Who is...

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: ...Rahu...

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: ...Rahu, where are you... What time is it already... are you still asleep?
...So annoying... I'm not asleep... Who the hell are you...

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: For god's sake, I'm your captain! Your boss! Your commander!

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: How many times do I have to tell you? You're part of the FAC now, so you have to obey orders! When will this get through your thick skull?

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: You're an FAC soldier, and our mission is to form the frontline of defense. Any weakness in that line will cause countless deaths in the city behind us.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Obey without questions. No doubts, no hesitations. Execute every order with utmost loyalty, just like a knight protects his lord. Is that clear?

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: I usually tolerate you slacking off, but you're not allowed to mess up this mission! If we do well, we'll get medals, as well as a pay raise and vacation days. Don't mess this up for me!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...And if we don't do well, we'll just die. You've got some nerve to call yourself a <i>loyal knight<i> when you're salivating over pay raises and vacation days.

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Hey... how dare you talk back?!

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Enough with that. Now take those blasted shields of yours and hurry!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Where to?

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: DisSea, of course. Are you still sleeping? This is the biggest operation since the Carnival. Top secret campaign directly commanded by Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...DisSea... a huge campaign... N.F. 103?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: <size=42><color=#fb9259>N.F. 103?</color></size>
Her mind is finally clearing up, but the people in front of her begin to leave.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...No, don't go, that mission is...

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Ha, I thought nothing scared you? What are you afraid of? Stay focused on the battlefield. Don't go rampaging alone. You just have to remember one thing...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No, listen to me, wait!

steps.speaker: Dazed Voice
steps.content: Listen to my command, and listen to your superiors! Remember that, knights of the FAC! Let's head out!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: <size=42>Don't go!!<size=42>
It's a dream.
She puts on her mask, her throbbing veins gradually calming down.
There's no danger nearby. The sky is getting brighter as the cold morning approaches. It's time to wake up from this dream.
She quickly brings her breathing under control. After calming herself down, Rahu picks up her shields and walks out firmly into the quiet garden beset by malice.
